method: Three independent lenses (experience, truth, platform) audited the live site; a judge spot-checked evidence, dropped weak or duplicate findings and ranked the rest.

audits.summary: For the John Summit friend, the app loses track of the show when it matters: on Nov 20 at 5:30pm Today leads with Little River and Key Biscayne and never says "Doors 7pm, Kaseya Center", there is no Go link, transit, rideshare or bag info for Kaseya, and the Trip tab drops night 2 when the preset is tapped and forgets dates, landing time and energy on reload. For a generic visitor, the biggest problems are a John Summit trip shown to everyone, a first screen that never says Miami, Keep leading nowhere, thumb dead zones on the tear strip and time track, and deck controls that jump up to 59px between cards. Strengths: the decks fit the real hour (Coyo Taco open till 3am at 1am, The Corner at 4:30am), a stub reads in seconds, fling, psst, sealed hold, Keep and Copy plan all work, and the planner's pre-show pick (Pho Nam, 0.84 km from Kaseya) shows the data can already do this.

findings.title: On show day, Today ignores the show
findings.who: The John Summit friend on Nov 20 and 21, and any visitor with an event on their trip
findings.evidence: Clock set to Nov 20 at 5:30pm (shots/d-nov20-1730-0.png and -1.png). Top card is 'Sunny's at 5:15' in Little River, whose note says 'At the door by 5:15' when it is already 5:30. The deck also includes The Cleat on Key Biscayne. The trip ticket reads 'Today / Nov 20 to Nov 24' with no doors time or venue. The John Summit flyer is 4th in Tonight, off screen to the right, behind two Book Fair flyers and Chris Lorenzo. Later offers 7pm Double Luck and 8pm Jass Kitchen, both during the show. The data has 7 moves within 2 km of Kaseya (Manolo & Rene 0.62 km, The Corner 0.78, Pho Nam 0.84, Cafe Fenicia 0.97, Kaona Room 1.17, The River 1.60), but only the Trip tab uses them.
findings.fix: TodayExtras.svelte: (1) add const day = $derived(trip.days.find((d) => d.date === app.now.date)) and const next = $derived(day?.slots.find((s) => s.at >= 24 || s.at % 24 >= app.now.hour - 0.25)). When next exists, the ticket shows {next.event ? 'Doors ' + fmtHour(next.at % 24, true) : fmtHour(next.at % 24, true)}{next.event ? next.event.venue : next.move.place}, so it reads 'Doors 7pm / Kaseya Center', or '6pm / Pho Nam' before that. Keep the shows and stops counts. (2) Sort Tonight with anchored events first: add .sort((a, b) => trip.anchors.includes(b.id) - trip.anchors.includes(a.id)) before .slice(0, 4). (3) state.svelte.js later: on a day with an anchored show, drop items between doors minus 1h and doors plus 4h.

findings.title: No way to get to Kaseya, and no bag rule, anywhere in the app
findings.who: The John Summit friend, and every visitor going to a show
findings.evidence: The Trip event slot offers only 'Tickets' (e-trip.log: 'Tickets | Tickets'; std/mobile-trip-scrolled.png). The flyer info panel has the why line, 'Kaseya Center, 7:00pm' and Tickets (shots/f2-event-open.png). Neither has a Go or map link for the venue. Every visible field in moves, events and hotels was searched for metromover, metrorail, airport, uber, lyft, rideshare, bag policy, dress code and parking. The only hits are parking notes for Matheson and the Barnacle, 'free parking' at the Vagabond and 'free Metromover' at EAST. Nothing covers getting from MIA, getting home after the show, or bags. kaseyacenter.com (A-Z Guide, Directions & Parking, FAQ) says: bags up to 10 x 6 x 2 in; Binbox lockers on the South Plaza above Gate 7 from $10, from 1h before doors to 1h after the show; rideshare at Bayshore Dr and HEAT Blvd, use Gate 6; Metrorail to Government Center, then the Omni Loop to Park West; Metromover runs 5am to midnight, sometimes to 1am after events. Some event pages override the bag size (Drake listed 14 x 14 x 6).
findings.fix: data/events.json, both john-summit records: add "getThere": "Metromover Omni Loop to Park West. Rideshare drops at Bayshore Dr and HEAT Blvd, Gate 6.", "bring": "Bags up to 10 x 6 x 2 in. Lockers by Gate 7 from $10.", "after": "Metromover runs till midnight.". Add the kaseyacenter.com A-Z guide, directions-parking and event page as sources, with a checked date. Recheck the John Summit event page for a tour-specific bag size before Nov 20. Render these as up to three one-line notes in TripView.svelte .ev-t and WallView.svelte .info. Add a Go link next to Tickets in the Trip event slot, using Stub.svelte's maps URL pattern with e.venue + ' ' + e.address. Do not add what-to-wear copy: nothing sources it. Run sync-data.mjs.

findings.title: Trip drops night 2 and forgets the friend's inputs on reload
findings.who: The John Summit friend, and anyone who sets real dates or flight times
findings.evidence: e-trip.log. A fresh load anchors both nights. Tapping 'This weekend' and then 'John Summit weekend' leaves only 'night 1', because the preset anchors only the Nov 20 event (TripView.svelte: e.id.includes('john-summit') && e.date === '2026-11-20'). That contradicts DECISIONS Planner rules: 'Both John Summit nights are anchored.' Second bug: I set Leave to Nov 23, landing to 4pm and energy to Loud, then reloaded. Everything went back to Nov 24, 3pm and Balanced, and localStorage psst.trip.v1 was null. persist() is called only in toggleAnchor (state.svelte.js), contradicting DECISIONS Engineering: 'Trip inputs ... persist.' The preset highlight is local $state('summit'), so it would also claim 'John Summit weekend' over custom dates.
findings.fix: TripView.svelte: set the summit preset to anchor: (e) => e.id.includes('john-summit'). Add $effect(() => { trip.start; trip.end; trip.arrive; trip.depart; trip.wild; trip.anchors; trip.persist(); }). Replace let preset = $state('summit') with const preset = $derived(presets.find((p) => p.start === trip.start && p.end === trip.end)?.k ?? 'custom'). Add a plan-check.mjs assertion that the summit preset anchors 2 events.

findings.title: Every visitor gets a stranger's John Summit trip
findings.who: Locals, Art Basel visitors, and anyone opening a shared link
findings.evidence: Live cold load (shots/live-m-scroll1.png, shots/live-d-3s.png): a first-time visitor who set nothing sees the ticket '42 days to John Summit, 2 shows, 14 stops'. TodayExtras.svelte: with no dates, the ticket reads Your tripAdd your dates. WallView.svelte: let pick = $state(trip.start && trip.end >= today ? 'stay' : 'tonight'). StayView.svelte: measure to the first anchored venue on the trip and name that venue; hide the line when nothing is anchored.

findings.title: First screen never says Miami or what psst does
findings.who: First-time visitors, especially friends in another time zone
findings.evidence: Live phone view at 1:08am (shots/live-m-3s.png): the wordmark, 'Fri, Oct 9 86°', a big 1:08am clock, the sky track, 8 mood icons, a Coyo Taco stub and the psst button. The word Miami appears nowhere on screen. The promise exists only in the meta description ('The right move at the right hour in Miami.'). The clock shows Miami time but says so only in its aria-label. Nothing shows the track can be dragged, and the 6 blue rain ticks around 2 to 5pm are explained only by a title attribute, which touch never shows. Desktop is the same (shots/live-d-3s.png). What does land within 10 seconds: the stub is an obvious recommendation (place, open till 3am, what to do, Keep, Go).
findings.fix: App.svelte header: Miami, {fmtDate(app.now.date, ...)}, which reads 'Miami, Fri Oct 9'. TimeHead.svelte lede(): when there is no psst.v2 in storage and app.following is true, return 'Drag the sun. The deck follows.' It uses the empty lede slot and stops after the first scrub. Check it against 'No explanatory footers' before shipping.

findings.title: Keep leads nowhere
findings.who: Every visitor who keeps moves; it is also the experiment's 'kept 3 or more' metric
findings.evidence: With one kept move (Coyo, Wynwood), Kept opens on the code box and then two pages of grey ghost slots (Little Havana 0/5, Downtown and Brickell 0/10) before the kept sticker appears (shots/h1-kept.png). The 59 ghost slots are plain spans, not buttons (f-tabs.log: ghosts 59, buttons 1), so a visitor cannot find out what No. 015 DOMINO is. planStay in core.js never reads app.kept, so moves kept on Today never shape the trip.
findings.fix: BookView.svelte: when app.kept.length > 0, add a 'Yours' page above the neighborhood pages listing each kept move (Sticker, title, best hour, Go link, Went toggle). With nothing kept, show one line: 'Tear a stub to keep it.' Make ghost slots buttons that open the move (app.where = m.id), except sealed ones. core.js planStay: take a kept list and add if (kept.includes(m.id)) sc += 0.6 to the ranking; TripState passes app.kept.

findings.title: Thumb dead zones on Today: tear strip and time track
findings.who: Every phone visitor scrolling Today
findings.evidence: a-gestures run, touch sent through Chrome's real input pipeline. A vertical swipe that starts on the tear-off strip (y 534 to 596 on the first screen, full card width) does not scroll: scrollTop stays 0, because .tearoff has touch-action: pan-x. Dragging down 120px on the same strip keeps the move (kept became ['jass-kitchen-candlelit-jazz']), so pulling to scroll back up tears the stub by accident. A vertical swipe that starts on the time track (touch-action: none, y 160 to 194) jumps the hour from 8:00pm to 12:00pm. For comparison, fling and vertical scroll on the card face both behave correctly.
findings.fix: Stub.svelte: .tearoff { touch-action: pan-y } and .tearoff .no { touch-action: none; cursor: grab }, and in pullStart add if (!e.target.closest('.no')) return;. Drag-to-tear moves to the serial tab and the rest of the strip scrolls; the accepted tear gesture stays. TimeHead.svelte: .track { touch-action: pan-y }. For pointerType 'touch', set the hour on pointerup only if the finger moved less than 8px, and start scrubbing only once horizontal movement exceeds vertical by 8px.

findings.title: Deck controls jump up to 59px between cards
findings.who: Phone visitors tapping Next or psst repeatedly
findings.evidence: b-controls and c-today runs. Centre y of the Next arrow, card by card: at 8pm 679, 702, 651 (sealed), 672, 672, 702; at 11:30pm 743, 743, 692, 720, 743, ..., 751. Stub heights range from 265 to 344px (9am 312 to 344, 11:30pm 265 to 321). After a 51 to 59px jump, a second tap on the 44px arrow misses.
findings.fix: Deck.svelte: .stack { min-height: 374px; } (the tallest stub, 344px, plus 30px padding). Stub.svelte: .sealed { min-height: 312px }, so the sealed card matches a normal stub. The controls then stay put at 390px.

findings.title: Planner puts moves on days their own note rules out
findings.who: The John Summit friend reading the plan; it undermines trust
findings.evidence: e-trip.log plan for Nov 20 to 24: Sat Nov 21 at 2pm is 'ICA Miami, free', whose note says 'Weekday afternoon.' (shots/e4-after-dayhead.png). Mon Nov 23 at 10pm is 'Monterrey Bar's record room', whose note says 'Friday or Saturday.' noteDays() is used in rankNow (core.js:129), but planStay checks only titleDays (core.js:241), and plan-check.mjs has no note-day check.
findings.fix: core.js planStay pool filter, after the titleDays line: const nd = noteDays(m); if (nd && !nd.includes(dowAt)) return false;. Add the same assertion to scripts/plan-check.mjs.

findings.title: Secret mood shows the same deck as All
findings.who: Visitors who tap Secret and see nothing change

findings.title: Go always opens Apple Maps, including on Android
findings.who: Android visitors: Go is the main action on every stub
findings.evidence: Stub.svelte line 303: <a class="go" href={apple}>. The captured href is https://maps.apple.com/?q=Jass%20Kitchen&ll=25.817736,-80.19172. The back face repeats it as an 'Apple Maps' pill.

findings.title: Tap targets under 44px on frequent controls
findings.who: Phone visitors
findings.evidence: Measured at 390px: More 53x25 and Back 52x25 on the stub, Swap 57x27 on Trip, the hotel card close button 26x26, event tear-tab row 35 to 41px tall, source links 15px tall. These pass: Keep 72x44, Go 55x44, arrows 44x44, moods 50x62, tab bar 76x55.
findings.fix: Stub.svelte and TripView.svelte: .more, .b-close, .swap { position: relative } plus ::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -10px -4px }, a 45px hit area with no layout change. StayView.svelte: .x { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center }. WallView.svelte: .tabs span { padding: 14px 2px 15px }.

findings.title: Copied plan link doesn't carry the plan
findings.who: Friends receiving the plan in a group chat

findings.title: Michelin Key star is wrong twice, and nothing explains it

findings.fix: StayView.svelte: const keyed = (h) => (h.perks || []).some((p) => /michelin keys?/i.test(p));. In .rl, append ★ Michelin Key when the row contains a keyed hotel.

findings.title: En dash in flyer date ranges

findings.title: Header temperature is the day's high, from a week-old forecast
findings.who: Visitors checking the weather at night
findings.evidence: At 1:08am the header shows 86° (the day's high) while weather.json hourly for Oct 9 at 1am is 83°. weather.json was fetched 2026-10-02, so from Oct 18 every day falls back to typical values.
findings.fix: App.svelte: {wx.hourly?.[Math.floor(app.hour)]?.[0] ?? wx.hi}°. Rerun scripts/weather.mjs before each deploy.

findings.title: Any made-up PINA code adds a secret
findings.who: The weekly secret limit; the group-chat code loses meaning
findings.evidence: Redeeming the invented 'PINA-ABCDE' gave '+1 secret.' and raised '3 secrets this week' to 4 (f-tabs.log). 'PINA-ABCD1' is rejected with 'Try PINA-XXXXX.' and no hint that 0, 1, I and O are never used.
findings.fix: TripView.svelte code: make the 5th character a checksum of the first 4 (A[(sum of their indexes) % 32]). state.svelte.js redeem(): reject codes whose checksum fails with 'That code doesn't match.'

What it does: (1) Precaches '/', /site.webmanifest, /favicon.svg, /icon-192.png and /apple-touch-icon.png. icons.mjs always emits these; addAll fails the whole install if one returns 404. (2) Page loads go to the network first. After 4 s, or with no signal, they fall back to the cached '/', and to the pending network response if nothing is cached. (4) It never touches /_vercel/. Register it in app/src/main.js after mount: if (import.meta.env.PROD && 'serviceWorker' in navigator) addEventListener('load', () => navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js').catch(() => {})). decisions.title: Who sees the John Summit trip by default
decisions.recommendation: Show the John Summit trip only to people who have saved a trip, or who arrive through psst.miami/?trip=summit (codeFromUrl applies the summit preset). Send the friend that link. Everyone else gets the ticket 'Your trip / Add your dates', Events opens on Tonight, and Stay measures to the first anchored venue, hiding the line when nothing is anchored. Today every first-time visitor, local or Art Basel guest sees '42 days to John Summit, 2 shows, 14 stops', Events opens on Nov 20 to 24, and every hotel card measures to Kaseya (live-m-scroll1.png, std/mobile-wall.png).
decisions.tradeoff: Round 3 put the trip ticket under the deck 'so the value shows on the first screen'. An empty ticket shows less until someone sets dates. In exchange, strangers stop seeing a stranger's plan. Ship the persistence fix first so saved trips keep their dates.

decisions.title: Daily rebuild so the forecast stays fresh
decisions.recommendation: After the build-time weather fetch ships, add a Vercel Deploy Hook in the vercel.com dashboard (personal SK scope) and call it once a day from a scheduled GitHub Action in the private repo, with the hook URL stored as a repo secret. Do this before Nov 15, so the trip days show a real forecast in the week before the visit.
decisions.tradeoff: It adds one moving part and a daily deploy to Vercel usage. Without it, the forecast is only as fresh as the last push, and the 4-day guard falls back to typical values between pushes.

decisions.title: First screen says Miami
decisions.recommendation: Header reads 'Miami, Fri Oct 9' (App.svelte line 82). Hold the drag hint ('Drag the sun. The deck follows.' in the empty lede slot, shown only before the first scrub), because it is close to the 'No explanatory footers' rule, even though the empty deck already says 'Drag the sun forward.' The word Miami appears nowhere on the live first screen; the promise lives only in the meta description (live-m-3s.png).
decisions.tradeoff: Adding 'Miami' costs about 45px of header width at 390px next to '86° forecast'; check that it doesn't wrap. A drag hint helps first-timers but adds narrated UI to a screen Round 3 cleaned of it.

decisions.title: What Keep leads to
decisions.recommendation: When something is kept, add a 'Yours' page at the top of Kept that lists each kept move with its best hour, Go and Went, and give planStay a +0.6 bonus for kept moves. Today one kept move sits below the code box and two pages of grey ghost slots (h1-kept.png), and planStay never reads app.kept. With nothing kept, show one line: 'Tear a stub to keep it.'
decisions.tradeoff: The sticker book by neighborhood is the collecting device. A list page dilutes it, and a planner bias changes plans people have already copied. 'Kept 3 or more' is an experiment metric, so Keep needs a payoff.

decisions.title: Does the copied plan link carry the plan
decisions.recommendation: Yes. Append &trip=START_END&a=ANCHOR_IDS to the link in TripView copy(), and in codeFromUrl apply the dates and anchors, then open Trip, but only when the person receiving it has no saved trip. Today the link only redeems the code, so the friend opens psst on its default trip, not the days they were sent.
decisions.tradeoff: It makes a longer link in the chat, and it can overwrite the receiver's own trip unless it is guarded. The plan text in the chat already carries the days.

decisions.title: Share image framed for chat
decisions.recommendation: Keep the golden-hour screen, but render it as the 390x844 Today view at 2x, placed right of center on a 1200x630 canvas painted #FCA864. Put the wordmark at about 140px on the left, with the line 'The right move at the right hour.', and keep both inside the central 630x630 square so square crops still show them. At iMessage bubble width the current og.png reads as a tiny desktop screenshot with a 10px wordmark (og-preview-sim.png).
decisions.tradeoff: It changes how the decided shareable visual is presented, and og.mjs gets more complex. The group-chat preview is the first impression for every friend you send it to.

decisions.title: noindex, and the Objective line in DECISIONS
decisions.recommendation: Keep noindex through the Dec 7 experiment so the cohort stays your network, and add an X-Robots-Tag: noindex header for /(.*) in vercel.json so og.png and the icons stay out of image search. Update the Objective line, which still says 'Delivered as a private link. Not deployed publicly', to match psst.miami with analytics.
decisions.tradeoff: Friends who search 'psst miami' instead of typing the domain won't find it until noindex is lifted.
